research.title: Lexical Shortcut Sensitivity in Natural Language Inference
bullets: Designed experiments with supervisor guidance to examine whether lexical overlap influences inference predictions, using controlled sentence pairs and label balanced evaluation sets.
Compared transformer classifier behavior across original and perturbed inputs, analyzing prediction changes by negation, word order, and overlap patterns.

work.title: Inventory and Order Coordination
bullets: Maintained inventory logs, checked incoming deliveries against order paperwork, and flagged discrepancies for follow-up by responsible staff.
Prepared routine order documents, organized supply requests, and coordinated collection schedules while keeping outstanding requests and delivery records current.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Short Text Classifiers
bullets: Implemented TF-IDF logistic regression and a convolutional text classifier for topic classification, using shared training partitions and consistent text preprocessing.
Compared macro F score and classwise confusion patterns, examining errors associated with rare vocabulary, short inputs, and overlapping topic terminology.

projects.title: Extractive Summarization with Sentence Ranking
bullets: Implemented frequency based and graph based sentence ranking methods for document summarization, applying shared sentence segmentation and summary length constraints.
Compared summaries using ROUGE and manual error categorization, examining redundancy, missing central information, and sensitivity to sentence position.
